member.name: M:NationalInstruments.TestStand.SemiconductorModule.InstrumentControl.Scope.Fetch(System.Int32,System.Double)
member.summary: Returns the waveform from a previously initiated acquisition that the digitizer acquires for the specified channel. This method returns scaled voltage waveforms. Refer to Using Fetch Functions for more information on using this method.
member.param: The maximum number of samples to fetch for each waveform. If the acquisition finishes with fewer points than requested, some instruments return partial data if the acquisition finished, was aborted, or a timeout of 0 was used. Use –1 for this parameter if you want to fetch all available samples. The method reads the actual record length and attempts to acquire all available samples. If it fails to complete within the timeout period, the method returns an error.
The time to wait for data to be acquired. Using 0 for this parameter tells NI-SCOPE to fetch whatever is currently available. Using -1 for this parameter implies infinite timeout.
member.returns: A collection of NationalInstruments.AnalogWaveform objects array, one per calling session.
